objective: Prove that for bit LeftPigeon with n + 1 pigeons the top bit of a hole row decodes to a single pigeon, so that every row-linear monomial with two top hole bits lies in the decoder's kernel, and that consequently Braun's criterion applied through the decoder certifies at most a constant number of lines, for every degree and accuracy.
status: Proved 2026-11-10: for bit LeftPigeon with n + 1 pigeons the top hole bit decodes to the single pigeon n, so row-linear monomials with two top hole bits lie in the decoder's kernel, and Braun's criterion applied through Theorem (R) certifies at most 3S + |J| >= 5.2 for every degree and accuracy: the decoder route is closed for this encoding (stop rule b). The 2n-pigeon principle, which contains LP_n's clauses, escapes the obstruction.
title: The top hole bit closes the decoder route
